description: Hand-reviewed corrections to the canonical client list produced by the two AI classification passes. These are human decisions, not model output: they override whatever canonical_name the model assigned to the listed raw folder names. Applied mechanically by the client-list build so they survive any re-run of the pipeline.
matching: raw_names are matched on the normalized key produced by normalizeName() in scripts/grants-lib.mjs (trim, strip trailing whitespace and .,;:_-*, collapse internal whitespace, lowercase). The strings below are the folder names exactly as they appear in Dropbox. strategy_folders lists folder names from SALES/*Annual Strategic Meetings/Client Strategy Meeting Reports. Those folders are not part of dist/inventory/resolved-final.csv, so they are kept OUT of raw_names — listing them there would make build-final-clients.mjs report them as "not found in resolved list". They record the same human decision and become live when the Strategy Reports tree is folded into the universe.
